methods.raw_bytes: both endian byte orders, every file byte
methods.arm64_constants: adjacent MOVZ then MOVK, same register and width, instruction sections only

observations.statement: The primary executable, LogicAppFramework, Logic, and MACore were scanned first in both raw endian orders. The only primary raw hit was little-endian sPkc in Logic __LINKEDIT; there were no raw aUeV, Spt2, or sPmo hits.

The expanded scan examined 106 unique Mach-O files in the app bundle without parse/read errors. All 9 raw hits were little-endian sPkc (bytes 63 6b 50 73) inside the same enclosing NUL-terminated Swift symbol string _$ss5ClockPss010ContinuousA0VRszrlE10continuousADvgZ in __LINKEDIT. These substring hits supply no evidence of an sPkc AppleEvent handler.
Logic __TEXT,__text contains adjacent MOVZ w0,#0x6556 and MOVK w0,#0x6155,lsl#16 at file offset/unslid VA 0x4f11e4 and 0x4f11e8. The resulting constant is 0x61556556, the big-endian OSType aUeV.
Logic __TEXT,__text contains adjacent MOVZ w1,#0x7432 and MOVK w1,#0x5370,lsl#16 at file offset/unslid VA 0x4f11ec and 0x4f11f0. The resulting constant is 0x53707432, the big-endian OSType Spt2.

The adjacent arm64 MOVZ/MOVK scan found no sPmo or sPkc constants. This method does not cover nonadjacent materialization, other instructions, x86 code, external shared libraries, or runtime-generated values, so the result does not prove absence of such handlers.

limitations: A raw byte hit can be unrelated code or data; no handler semantics are inferred.
The instruction scan covers adjacent MOVZ/MOVK pairs only; absence of a hit does not exclude other constant synthesis.
Addresses are unslid Mach-O virtual addresses, not runtime process addresses.
No AppleEvents were sent and no app files were modified.
